trigger: Measured absorbance overlaps 465–505 nm excitation or 500–550 nm emission; or intrinsic fluorescence is reported in those bands
enhanced_QC_required: Compound-only fluorescence/absorbance correction or validated matched interference control
pass_condition: Residual signal shown nonmaterial at assay concentration
failure_consequence: Any missing spectrum/QC when overlap is known

trigger: Anthocyanin/betalain/strong visible chromophore class, or concentration-dependent quenching is reported
UV-visible chromophore without known overlap and assay concentration is above 10 µM
enhanced_QC_required: Spectrum, matched compound blank, or documented no-interference validation
pass_condition: No material interference at assay concentration

trigger: No visible chromophore/intrinsic fluorescence evidence and concentration ≤10 µM
Visible precipitation/turbidity, nonmonotonic response, or concentration exceeds documented aqueous solubility
evidence_required: Traceable experimental/literature/database solubility or logP/logD; assay concentration; precipitation/turbidity; dose response; stock-solvent evidence. If insufficient, classify UNCLEAR.
pass_condition: Clear solution and monotonic range below limit

trigger: Hydrophobic/poorly water-soluble compound requires organic stock or logP/solubility evidence indicates borderline exposure
evidence_required: Traceable experimental/literature/database solubility or logP/logD; assay concentration; precipitation/turbidity; dose response; stock-solvent evidence. If insufficient, classify UNCLEAR.
enhanced_QC_required: Concentration below plausible limit, dose response, controlled cosolvent, no precipitation evidence
failure_consequence: If solubility evidence or visual/dose response check missing

trigger: Aqueous/buffer soluble compound tested below documented or chemically plausible solubility
evidence_required: Traceable experimental/literature/database solubility or logP/logD; assay concentration; precipitation/turbidity; dose response; stock-solvent evidence. If insufficient, classify UNCLEAR.

trigger: Final organic cosolvent >5% v/v or RMCD/detergent materially changes assay arm
enhanced_QC_required: Matched solvent calibration/control plus kinetic equivalence or validated bridge
failure_consequence: Missing matched control is B2; incompatible arm may be C

enhanced_QC_required: Matched solvent control for samples and Trolox/blank

pass_condition: No kinetic anomaly and solvent interpretable

trigger: Quinone/quinone-like electrophore, documented redox cycling, prooxidant response, probe reaction or radical generation
evidence_required: Defined structure plus experimental/cited mechanistic evidence
enhanced_QC_required: Orthogonal control or kinetic evidence separating scavenging from probe/radical perturbation
failure_consequence: HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED if evidence incomplete
